headline: NatWest taps Nvidia speech recognition to help spending tool understand accents
body: NatWest has harnessed Nvidia AI speech recognition for its new audio-visual spending insights tool, to help it understand customers' accents and pronunciations.
note: For banks adding voice features, accent handling is a test that customer-facing tools have to pass.

evidence.text: NatWest has harnessed AI speech recognition technology from Nvidia to help its new audio-visual spending insights tool understand customers' accents and pronunciations.
